messages:
emma_cs: Quick weekly check-in for VelociPay re: caching + batching impact. TL;DR: overall token spend down 18% week-over-week, cache hit steady at 42%, average batch size 3.1, latency P95 up a bit. Thoughts?
josh_success: thanks — uploading the raw numbers here: https://redwood.internal/reports/velocipay/2026-03-12 (read-only). key columns: cache_hit, avg_batch, tokens_per_call, cost_per_1k.
daniel_se: skimmed — interesting that hit rate is stable but cost down. I think more batching on short prompts helped. Can you paste the avg batch by endpoint?
emma_cs: sure — top 3 endpoints: payment-check (batch 4.2, hit 51%), invoice-summary (batch 2.0, hit 19%), fraud-score (batch 3.5, hit 60%). Overall avg batch 3.1.
maria_sre: P95 latency increased from 210ms -> 260ms on payment-check. Error rate unchanged ~0.15%. Any deploys last night?
daniel_se: no infra deploys. We did push a quantized model variant for invoice-summary which lowered compute but might change batching behavior. Also enabled aggressive prefix caching for fraud-score.
emma_cs: cost_per_1k_tokens metric: last week $8.3 -> $6.8 this week. Savings mostly from batching + switching to q4_0 variant for invoice-summary.
josh_success: renewal flag: usage is up 9% monthly active calls; they're within committed tier but savings were a pleasant surprise for them. Recommend highlighting cost delta in the renewal deck.
emma_cs: agree. Action items: 1) eng to investigate payment-check P95 bump (maria/daniel), 2) CS to prepare one-slide cost delta and explain batching tradeoffs for renewal (josh/emma), 3) product to confirm if invoice-summary q4_0 has any quality regressions (daniel).
maria_sre: I'll trace latency — starting with heatmap for payment-check (hot path appears at decode step). Will post flame graph.
daniel_se: I'll run a quick A/B on invoice-summary against golden prompts (10 eval sets) — aim to finish by EOD tomorrow.
josh_success: one quick ask for the renewal deck: can we get cost_per_1k broken down by endpoint and by model variant? Clients like that granularity.
emma_cs: noted, will attach breakdown. Also capturing customer feedback: they said the faster fraud-score responses are "noticeably snappier" which helped UX.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline:velocipay-production reported no failed jobs in last 24h.
emma_cs: closing notes — overall health: green for spend/usage, amber for latency on payment-check. Renewal risk: low but add cost wins to the narrative. Will follow up in next weekly. :thumbsup:
